The behavior observed in the code matches the issue report's symptoms, indicating that missing escaping in this method is the likely root cause.

messages.content:
Title: Diagnosis

Details: The provided failing test case org.apache.commons.lang.text.StrBuilderTest.testLang295() constructs a StrBuilder with the string "onetwothree", then calls deleteFirst("three") and afterwards asserts that the character 'h' is no longer contained in the StrBuilder.

The deleteFirst(String) method works by finding the first occurrence of the given string and then calling deleteImpl to remove it from the buffer.

The contains(char) method iterates over the internal buffer array using thisBuf.length as the limit to check if a character is contained.

The core bug described in the report is that the method contains(char) uses buffer length for iteration rather than the logical size of the content. The internal buffer array is often larger than the actual used size (field size). When deleteFirst("three") removes "three", size is decreased accordingly by deleteImpl, but the buffer length stays the same.

Because contains uses thisBuf.length (whole buffer capacity) rather than size (the actual length of the stored content), it may look into uninitialized or old content beyond the logical end of the string data, making the contains(char) check incorrect.

Consequently, in the test case after deleting "three", the char 'h' might still be found in the buffer array beyond the actual content size if the buffer length is used for iteration rather than size.

Therefore, the root cause is that the contains(char) method incorrectly uses thisBuf.length to control the loop which should instead use the current logical size of the content.

This diagnosis aligns with the bug report summary that mentions "StrBuilder contains usages of thisBuf.length when they should use size" and the test failure evidences an off-by-length issue with searching.

---

Next recommended fix locations would be places where contains and similar methods iterate using thisBuf.length rather than size.
org.apache.commons.lang.text.StrBuilder.contains(char)
